name: ecommerce-operations
description: Prepare concrete ecommerce catalog, price, promotion, stock and order-exception changes; apply and verify them only through available connected tools supporting the action. Use for operating changes and previews, not selection, copywriting or analytical diagnosis.
description_it: Prepara modifiche concrete a catalogo, prezzi, promozioni, stock ed eccezioni ordini e-commerce; applicale e verificalo solo tramite i tool connessi che supportano l'azione. Usala per modifiche operative e preview, non per selezione, copywriting o diagnosi analitica.
